description: Closed clarification slot vocabulary (docs/v2/stage4-design.md §8, D13). A structured clarification may only name these slots; user_turns[].on_clarify and expected_answerability.clarify.slots may only reference them. Size or colour variants are distinct SKUs in this domain, so a target variant is expressed as target_sku.

slots.meaning: Which order the request is about (an order number such as ORD-1001).
Which line item of an order the request is about, when the order has several items.
The SKU the customer wants to exchange to (for example another size of the same product).
Why the customer wants the return or exchange (for example quality problem or size).
